connector.name: Exec Sandbox
connector.registryDescription: Single exec tool running caller Python in a network-isolated locked-down sandbox.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image mcp-exec:v0.5.4. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the inhuman account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MCP_EXEC_TRANSPORT
env.description: MCP transport. Must be 'stdio' for direct docker/stdio use.

env.name: MCP_EXEC_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S
env.description: Default wall-clock timeout per exec, seconds.

env.name: MCP_EXEC_MAX_TIMEOUT_S
env.description: Maximum wall-clock timeout a caller may request, seconds.

env.name: MCP_EXEC_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
env.description: Cap on combined stdout/stderr before truncation.

env.name: MCP_EXEC_MAX_STDIN_BYTES
env.description: Cap on stdin passed to the sandboxed code.
